behavior: SamplerCopyPlan borrows the exact configured sampler and fixed Box history; preparation checks extents without allocation or sampling.
Full boxed capacity, including cleared and spare slots, is copied once; standard controls and updated Mirostat adaptive state are preserved.
Existing configured and standalone sampler clone paths use the same history-copy worker; speculative copy accounting and native logical snapshot estimates use exact history capacity.
Native sampling copies preserve and independently copy existing RNG without drawing; six subsequent stochastic samples match, and history/key remain valid after source retirement.
IsolatedArrayCopy shares a closed Contiguous(false)-then-DeepCopy program between actual native workers and Workspace tracing.
Ordinary pending/RNG and concatenating KV snapshot workers consume borrowed copy plans under existing recovery/retention ownership.
Dense copies preserve all cache metadata and actual stored slots. Source aliases deduplicate only the opening inventory; each requested K/V destination remains independent.

Existing-array projection uses housekeeping-free nonblocking descriptor snapshots, preserving typed metadata errors. Unknown or unsupported native storage never becomes known by evaluation during tracing.
Existing hybrid, compressed, paged, pooling and ordinary state-projection/snapshot tests remain passing.
limits: This increment supplies component copy plans, not complete finite snapshot or branch execution funding. Existing quoted MLX sampler-copy rejection remains.
Sampler payload accounting excludes allocator metadata, native RNG/state, enclosing ownership and other continuation payloads. Logical SnapshotEstimate remains a logical ledger input.
Native source-borrow plans require caller-owned settled/exclusive source custody. They are not detached immutable physical certificates and grant no allocation/submission authority.
Array/copy trace reports are private diagnostic consumers until complete aggregate copy admission integrates exact source custody and destination funding.
Full controller/parser/capture, state-layout/input metadata, decoder, cursor, delivery and independently escaped public values remain separately unproved.
Three external checkpoint fixtures remain ignored. New synthetic native numerical tests ran; no new released-checkpoint, distributed or process/allocator-peak measurement is claimed.
Full family/path bounded inference goal remains incomplete.
